scope.zh: 一个业务问题、流程与数据基线、下一阶段SOW；约2个有效周，客户日历4-8周。
scope.en: One problem, workflow / data baseline and next-stage SOW; about two active weeks across 4-8 calendar weeks.

scope.zh: 一种凭证、两类参与方、最多3个接口和一个测试流程；约6个技术周，客户日历8-16周。
scope.en: One credential, two roles, up to three interfaces and one test workflow; about six technical weeks across 8-16 calendar weeks.

scope.zh: 一个运营主体、一个流程、最多3个既有系统接口；24人周，客户日历基线4个月。
scope.en: One operator, one workflow and up to three existing-system interfaces; 24 person-weeks over a four-month baseline.

scope.zh: 每个上线项目每月1个人日支持USD700，加云与监测USD200；额外服务另报。
scope.en: Per live project: one support person-day USD 700 + cloud / monitoring USD 200 per month; extra work priced separately.

assumptions.zh: 未知费用保留null，不以零元代替。合计、完整销售贡献、回本收入及资金缺口均待定。
assumptions.en: Unknowns remain null, never zero. Totals, full contribution, break-even and funding gaps remain TBD.

assumptions.zh: 租金2500与燃油2000迪拉姆分别估算；燃油不代表市场平均或每月必花。按实际里程与油票复核。
assumptions.en: Rental2500 and fuel2000 dirhams are separate estimates; fuel is not a market average or mandatory monthly spend. Reconcile mileage / receipts.

assumptions.zh: 通信315迪拉姆/月仅取未优惠套餐加VAT参考，不保证相同20GB+300分钟组合、开户资格或长期价格。漫游与超额另核。
assumptions.en: AED315/month is an undiscounted plan plus VAT reference, not a guarantee of exact20GB+300-minute match, eligibility or ongoing price. Assess roaming / overages separately.

assumptions.zh: 费用不作薪酬要约；住宿、车辆、餐补等与未来薪酬安排分别讨论。机票统一按批准的实际支出处理。
assumptions.en: Expense references are not a pay offer. Discuss housing, vehicle and meals separately from future pay. Reimburse airfare at approved actuals.

assumptions.zh: 订单与交付规划保留，不因尚未谈薪酬而改变客户采购假设。产品毛利不等于扣除全部费用后的利润。
assumptions.en: Retain orders / delivery plans without changing client-demand assumptions. Product gross profit is not profit after all costs.
